title: Cyclotomic CRT Branch Factorization
theorem_summary: For every finite set S of split primes p congruent to 1 mod 3, the cyclotomic defect branches factor exactly by CRT: there are 2^|S| simultaneous classes modulo product p^2, with exact simultaneous density product 2/p^2 and exact avoidance density product (1-2/p^2).
